independent_test_groups: B and one provisional validation winner, only if eligible
selection: Predeclared: among D1..D4, require validation success >= B, crash <= B, OOR <= B and mean episode return > B. Rank eligible variants by success, then mean return. A winner is provisional, not a generalization claim. No eligible variant means no winner, no combination, no final100. Any advanced variant is independently tested on all20 sealed IDs; report CIs, including non-significant outcomes.
protocol_scope: A small independent one-factor validation screen; no repeated hyperparameter tuning, no automatic significance claim. Full100 evaluation is optional and is not replaced by these ten episodes.
